items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Eddie Haywood used to play for us in Atlanta

ctx.x: I'm wondering back in those days, what kind of music or band did you carry, any band with you? Any of the New Orleans musicians that early, or when did they start going out with you?
Eddie Haywood used to play. Oh, Eddie Haywood. Eddie Haywood used to play for us in Atlanta, and Professor Lovey Austin's father was playing where? Chattanooga.
